name: hava-mcp
description: Full Hava.io API access: list, search, export and manage cloud architecture diagrams for AWS, Azure, GCP and Kubernetes.
long_description:
Gives Claude 47 tools covering the Hava.io API: list and search the automatically generated architecture diagrams for your connected cloud accounts, query the underlying cloud resources, inspect version history, export any view to PNG, PDF, editable Visio (VSDX), CSV or JSON, manage notes and embeddable shares, trigger source re-imports, and administer teams, projects and API tokens.

Destructive operations require an explicit confirmation flag, and setting HAVA_MCP_READ_ONLY=1 removes every mutating tool from the list entirely. Tools that accept cloud credentials or mint API tokens put those secrets in the conversation transcript.

In Hava's API a diagram is an *environment* holding several *views* (infrastructure, extended, security, container, list); exports act on a view, so every listing returns the view IDs an export needs. Format and view combinations are validated before calling Hava, so unsupported pairs fail with a useful message instead of an HTTP 422.

Authentication is a single setting: paste your Hava API token into the field this extension asks for at install time. It is stored in your OS keychain and passed to the server as HAVA_API_TOKEN. There is no login step and the server stores nothing itself. API access requires a Hava Teams/Business plan or a self-hosted install.

macOS only. The API endpoint defaults to https://api.hava.io and is not asked for; set HAVA_ENDPOINT only if you run Hava self-hosted.

Requires `uv` (https://docs.astral.sh/uv) on your machine: this is a Python server and Claude Desktop ships no Python runtime. uv supplies Python 3.10+ and the dependencies on first launch. If uv is missing, the extension log explains how to install it.

Built by CloudZone against the Hava REST API v1.1.6. MIT licensed.

tools.name: hava_auth_status
tools.description: Report which Hava API token is in use, where it came from, and whether it works.

tools.name: hava_list_diagrams
tools.description: List all Hava diagrams (environments) in the account, one page at a time.

tools.name: hava_find_diagrams
tools.description: Find diagrams by name, or by the cloud resources they contain.

tools.name: hava_get_diagram
tools.description: Get one diagram with its views, sources, and optionally its resources.

tools.name: hava_list_diagram_versions
tools.description: List the version history of a diagram, newest first by default.

tools.name: hava_list_sources
tools.description: List the cloud accounts (AWS/Azure/GCP/Kubernetes sources) connected to Hava.

tools.name: hava_export_diagram
tools.description: Export one view of a Hava diagram to PNG, PDF, VSDX, CSV, or JSON.

tools.name: hava_get_job
tools.description: Check an asynchronous Hava job and collect its result.

tools.name: hava_list_diagram_notes
tools.description: List the notes people have left on a diagram.

tools.name: hava_create_diagram_note
tools.description: Add a note to a diagram, optionally tagging teammates.

tools.name: hava_delete_diagram_note
tools.description: Delete a note from a diagram.

tools.name: hava_list_diagram_shares
tools.description: List the embeddable shares that exist for a diagram.

tools.name: hava_get_diagram_share
tools.description: Get the details and configuration of one diagram share.

tools.name: hava_create_diagram_share
tools.description: Create a publicly accessible, embeddable link to a diagram.

tools.name: hava_update_diagram_share
tools.description: Change the configuration of an existing share (PNG render options).

tools.name: hava_create_diagram
tools.description: Create a new custom diagram from a Hava search query.

tools.name: hava_update_diagram
tools.description: Change the query or name of a custom diagram, triggering a rebuild.

tools.name: hava_delete_diagram
tools.description: Permanently delete a custom diagram and its entire version history.

tools.name: hava_list_teams
tools.description: List the teams in a Hava account, with their roles and members.

tools.name: hava_get_team
tools.description: Get one team with its roles and full member list.

tools.name: hava_create_team
tools.description: Create a team in the Hava account.

tools.name: hava_update_team
tools.description: Rename a team or change the roles it grants.

tools.name: hava_delete_team
tools.description: Delete a team, which also removes its members from the Hava account.

tools.name: hava_add_team_member
tools.description: Add an existing Hava user to a team by email.

tools.name: hava_invite_team_member
tools.description: Invite someone to Hava by email and add them to a team.

tools.name: hava_remove_team_member
tools.description: Remove a user from a team, revoking the access that team grants.

tools.name: hava_list_projects
tools.description: List the projects in a Hava account.

tools.name: hava_get_project
tools.description: Get one project with its description and members.

tools.name: hava_create_project
tools.description: Create a project for grouping environments and scoping access.

tools.name: hava_update_project
tools.description: Rename a project or change its description.

tools.name: hava_delete_project
tools.description: Delete a project, removing its grouping and per-project access.

tools.name: hava_add_project_member
tools.description: Give a user access to a project.

tools.name: hava_remove_project_member
tools.description: Revoke a user's access to a project.

tools.name: hava_list_api_tokens
tools.description: List the account's API tokens with their names and last-used times.

tools.name: hava_create_api_token
tools.description: Generate a new API token. The secret is shown once.

tools.name: hava_delete_api_token
tools.description: Revoke an API token.

tools.name: hava_list_reports
tools.description: List the reports available in the Hava account.

tools.name: hava_get_report
tools.description: Get one report's details and contents.

tools.name: hava_export_report
tools.description: Export a report to PDF, waiting for the job and returning a download link.

tools.name: hava_list_resources
tools.description: Find cloud resources across all connected accounts using a Hava query.

tools.name: hava_export_resources
tools.description: Export the full resource inventory for one or more cloud sources as JSON.

tools.name: hava_get_source
tools.description: Get one cloud source, including when it last synced.

tools.name: hava_sync_source
tools.description: Re-import a cloud account so its diagrams reflect current infrastructure.

tools.name: hava_create_source
tools.description: Connect an AWS account to Hava via a cross-account IAM role.

tools.name: hava_update_source_credentials
tools.description: Replace a source's cloud credentials (and optionally its name).

tools.name: hava_rename_source
tools.description: Rename a connected cloud source.

tools.name: hava_delete_source
tools.description: Disconnect a cloud source, deleting all its resources and diagrams.

api_token.title: Hava API token
api_token.description: Required. app.hava.io -> avatar -> Personal Settings -> API Tokens -> Display Token. Stored in your OS keychain. Needs a Hava Teams/Business plan or a self-hosted install.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Hide every tool that changes anything in Hava, leaving 19 read-only tools.
